purpose: Teach: 山積み/二日酔い/きもの/スライス/話しかける/掴み/じゃー/鍵盤

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題、本気で、絶対、山積みって、絶対、お母さんから、聞いたよ、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、応援
lines.en: Sho, I heard from your mom that your homework is piling up — but I'm really rooting for you.
lines.style: Warm and encouraging, like an older sister who genuinely believes in him. Soft attack, steady confidence. Lean in slightly with the reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、二日酔いで、絶対、辛そうなんだ、絶対、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、心配
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad looks like he's really struggling with a hangover. I'm worried about him.
lines.style: Quiet and observant, the way a small child notices something adults try to hide. Tender concern underneath, not alarm. Soft pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お正月、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、きもの、絶対、着てくるからね、翔くん、絶対、楽しみにしててね
lines.en: For New Year's I'm going to wear a kimono when I visit — you should look forward to it, okay?
lines.style: Bright promise, gentle teasing warmth. A beat of delight on the image of the kimono. Lean forward like sharing a secret treat.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お弁当、絶対、スライス、絶対、お肉、絶対、入っていて、絶対、嬉しいよ、メイ姉さん、絶対、感謝、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was so happy that the lunch box you made had those sliced meat pieces in it. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Simple, genuine joy without performance. Small and sincere, the way a six-year-old gives gratitude that actually means something. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お友達に、絶対、話しかけるの、絶対、得意よね、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Sho, you're really good at talking to your friends — I'm genuinely impressed by that.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, no exaggeration. Soft, steady delivery. Let the compliment breathe. Not gushing — just real recognition of something true about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、運動会で、絶対、優勝を、絶対、掴みたいよ、本気で、絶対、頑張る
lines.en: I want to win at the sports day — I'm going to try my absolute best.
lines.style: Quiet determination, small-boy resolve. Not shouting about it. Let the seriousness sit in his voice naturally. Steady breath, slight clench underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃー、翔くん、本気で、絶対、また、絶対、メイ姉さんち、絶対、遊びに来てね、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: So, Sho — come visit me again soon, okay? I promise.
lines.style: Warm and inviting, like an older sister who means it. Gentle on the closing. The promise carries real affection — not performative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ピアノの鍵盤、絶対、メイ姉さんと、絶対、一緒に、絶対、弾いてみたいよ、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: I really want to play the piano with you sometime, Mei-sis. I mean it.
lines.style: Soft, earnest wish-making. A six-year-old imagining something beautiful. Slow, careful delivery. Slight breathiness on the word piano. Trailing off with genuine hope.
